description: Derives OwnerCommitmentAt o (HasEsseInRe InAct esse) hasCausalPower w from the two in-act readings and ActualityOnlyInsofarAsBeingReading by composing each with the latter. A short composition, not a transcription: no premise's consequent is the conclusion, and concreteness is defined from InAct/esse, not from causation or power. It establishes the principle only conditionally on its three open premises.
